'''Fel Rock''' is a now corrupted cave in [[Teldrassil]]. This once beautiful cave is located just north of [[Dolanaar]] and is infested with many [[grell]]s. It is also home to the vicious [[satyr]] [[Lord Melenas]]. The [[night elf]] [[druid]] [[Tallonkai Swiftroot]] sends alliance players into this foreboding cave to destroy Lord Melenas during the quest '''Twisted Hatred'''.
